route_title: MgF2/HfO2 chirped mirror stack for broadband rejection
compilation_rationale: Bounded route specifies exact 20-layer MgF2/HfO2 sequence on fused silica. Thickness bounds initialized to 100 nm (quarter-wave equivalent near 700 nm) with ±50% deviation to accommodate chirped dispersion. Three mean-transmittance objectives isolate passband enhancement and dual stopband suppression per compiler policy. Smatrix solver handles coherent multilayer response. All requirements mapped without unsupported capabilities.
